note: 周进展站会十段人工双语草稿。表达依赖限p001-p350和本文件先前段落；未来回访不计实绩。音色待试听、音频60/40待核验，不含时间轴。

series.title: 云迁移周站会：说清进度与依赖
series.premise: 周三迁移站会确认周五测试就绪目标。网络已通，数据仍追赶，目标身份缺少受限密钥权限；生产切换另设审批。
series.outcome: 限定周五承诺为测试就绪并附数据、权限、容量验收条件。安排最小权限评审与测试支援，每日下午更新依赖，未达标则调整测试日期；不承诺本周生产切换。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 切换前必须满足的依赖

recycling.note: 未来候选仅作安排，不计实际复现。

dialogues.title: 周五目标是测试就绪
dialogues.premise: 周三站会开场，需要统一本周里程碑口径。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住测试就绪与生产切换的区别。

lines.en: Are we on track for Friday's rehearsal? I've got a hard stop at ten.
lines.zh: 周五演练是否按计划？我十点必须结束。

lines.en: First, Friday means testing readiness, not cutover. So, production approval needs a separate review.
lines.zh: 先明确，周五是测试就绪，不是切换。所以，生产批准需要独立评审。

lines.en: Yesterday I finished the private network route. Today I'll test service paths from both zones.
lines.zh: 昨天完成私网路由。今天从两个区测试服务路径。

lines.en: My test environment is mostly provisioned now. The application identity still needs key access.
lines.zh: 测试环境大部分已建好。应用身份仍需要密钥访问。

lines.en: Well, copying continues from the source database. Maybe another day before the backlog clears.
lines.zh: 嗯，数据仍从源数据库复制。积压可能还要一天清完。

lines.en: Just to confirm, source stays authoritative, right? What's the ETA for a firmer data estimate?
lines.zh: 确认一下，源端仍是权威数据源，对吧？更可靠的数据估时何时能给？

lines.en: Give the estimate after today's throughput sample. A copied percentage alone won't predict completion.
lines.zh: 今天吞吐样本后再估时。复制百分比本身不能预测完成。

lines.en: A production date now? Let's park that. Network readiness is only one of several gates.
lines.zh: 现在定生产日期？先放一边。网络就绪只是多个门槛之一。

lines.en: Right, I'll explain the permission gap next. We can resolve that without expanding everyone's access.
lines.zh: 对，接下来说明权限缺口。不用扩大所有人的访问权限就能解决。

lines.en: Just to recap, we're tracking rehearsal readiness. I'll keep migration estimates separate from release promises.
lines.zh: 小结一下，我们跟踪演练就绪。我会区分迁移估时与发布承诺。

dialogues.title: 路由已通，不代表业务路径都通
dialogues.premise: Raj汇报路由完成，补充今日网络测试和未决项。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别网络配置完成和应用路径验证完成。

lines.en: Okay, private connectivity works in both zones. Route tables match the approved network design.
lines.zh: 好，两个区私网均已连通。路由表符合批准设计。

lines.en: Well, what did yesterday's check actually cover? A route doesn't prove name resolution or authorization.
lines.zh: 嗯，昨天检查实际覆盖什么？路由不能证明名称解析或授权。

lines.en: Right, our smoke test covered internal DNS. Database connections wait for Hannah's permission review.
lines.zh: 对，关键功能测试覆盖内部DNS。数据库连接等Hannah权限评审。

lines.en: The data channel uses a different identity. It's on track, but not application proof.
lines.zh: 数据通道用另一身份。它按计划推进，但不能证明应用可用。

lines.en: Good distinction, test the intended runtime identity. My admin session isn't an acceptable substitute.
lines.zh: 区分正确，要测预定运行身份。我的管理员会话不能替代。

lines.en: Just to confirm, business paths still pending, right? Raj owns both-zone tests by this afternoon.
lines.zh: 确认一下，业务路径仍待测，对吧？Raj今天下午前负责两区测试。

lines.en: Include failover routing without changing live traffic. Sandbox tests can expose asymmetric return paths.
lines.zh: 不改线上流量也测故障切换路由。沙箱测试能暴露非对称回程。

lines.en: I'm on it for that test matrix. Maybe two hours once the identity works.
lines.zh: 我来做测试矩阵。身份可用后可能两小时。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on permission approval. Until then, mark those cases as untested.
lines.zh: 我关注权限审批。此前把这些用例标为未测试。

lines.en: So, I'll share critical endpoint details now. That keeps the test scope tied to consumers.
lines.zh: 所以，现在分享关键端点信息。让测试范围与消费者对应。

dialogues.title: 九成完成不等于快追平
dialogues.premise: 私网就绪，Anika汇报数据复制进度与完成估算依据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出复制积压、持续写入和数据一致性检查。

lines.en: Okay, the replication checkpoint advanced last night. Initial copying is roughly ninety percent complete.
lines.zh: 好，复制检查点昨晚推进了。初始复制约完成百分之九十。

lines.en: The last tables might be the largest. What's the backlog size alongside incoming writes?
lines.zh: 最后几张表可能最大。积压多大，新增写入又多少？

lines.en: Right, backlog is shrinking at current throughput. We'll catch up if that rate holds.
lines.zh: 对，当前吞吐下积压正在缩小。维持速率就能追上。

lines.en: Well, check counts and sampled checksums too. Low lag alone doesn't prove matching data.
lines.zh: 嗯，也查计数和抽样校验和。低延迟本身不证明数据一致。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no target writes yet, right? Source changes still drive the replication stream.
lines.zh: 确认一下，目标端尚无业务写入，对吧？源端变化仍驱动复制流。

lines.en: So, I'll keep an eye on throughput. Network saturation could change that estimate this afternoon.
lines.zh: 所以，我关注吞吐。网络饱和可能在下午改变估时。

lines.en: What happens if replication pauses for hours? Source log retention must cover the interruption.
lines.zh: 复制停几小时怎么办？源日志保留必须覆盖中断。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis allows a short interruption. Longer gaps need a fresh copy assessment.
lines.zh: 当前假设允许短中断。更长缺口需要评估重新复制。

lines.en: What's the ETA for today's checksum sample? I'll reserve a test slot after it.
lines.zh: 今天校验和抽样预计何时完成？之后我预留测试时段。

lines.en: Okay, Anika posts that estimate after lunch. Keep confidence and assumptions beside the date.
lines.zh: 好，Anika午饭后发布估时。日期旁写置信程度和假设。

dialogues.title: 缺密钥权限，不借管理员绕过
dialogues.premise: 应用路径测试受目标运行身份权限阻塞，明确需审批的最小范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住阻塞对象、负责人与禁止捷径。

lines.en: Okay, we're blocked on target key permissions. The runtime role can't decrypt the test credentials.
lines.zh: 好，受阻于目标密钥权限。运行角色不能解密测试凭据。

lines.en: Right, private connectivity isn't blocking us here. The denial names the intended key identifier.
lines.zh: 对，这次阻塞不是私网连通。拒绝记录明确指向预定密钥标识。

lines.en: Request access to that key and action. Don't grant broad administrator rights to unblock testing.
lines.zh: 只申请该密钥和操作访问。不要为解阻塞授予管理员权限。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Hannah owns the request, right? Who has bandwidth for the security review?
lines.zh: 确认一下，Hannah负责申请，对吧？谁有空做安全评审？

lines.en: Our security reviewer is available after lunch. I'll send the denial and consumer context.
lines.zh: 安全评审者午饭后有空。我发送拒绝记录和消费者背景。

lines.en: Well, key policy needs review as well. A role policy alone may not enable access.
lines.zh: 嗯，密钥策略也要评审。仅角色策略可能不能启用访问。

lines.en: I'm on it for the identity check. We'll verify the role actually assumed at runtime.
lines.zh: 我来核验身份。确认运行时实际承担的角色。

lines.en: So, don't paste credentials into status threads. Share redacted evidence through the approved channel.
lines.zh: 所以，不要把凭据贴到状态讨论。通过批准渠道分享脱敏证据。

lines.en: Maybe approval can finish before three today. The escalation path is our security duty reviewer.
lines.zh: 今天可能三点前批准。升级路径是安全值班评审者。

lines.en: Okay, no borrowed admin credentials for testing. That would hide the exact dependency we're tracking.
lines.zh: 好，不借管理员凭据测试。否则会掩盖正跟踪的依赖。

dialogues.title: 环境相似不等于可代表生产
dialogues.premise: 权限评审已排期，Hannah说明测试环境覆盖与剩余差异。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别测试结论的适用范围。

lines.en: Okay, environment parity covers versions and policies. Test quotas are lower than production quotas.
lines.zh: 好，环境一致性覆盖版本和策略。测试配额低于生产配额。

lines.en: Managed configuration builds both environments from templates. The account-specific inputs still need separate validation.
lines.zh: 统一配置从模板构建两个环境。账户专属输入仍需独立验证。

lines.en: So passing tests won't prove production capacity. Record quota differences and expected runtime identities.
lines.zh: 所以测试通过不证明生产容量。记录配额差异和预期运行身份。

lines.en: We're still blocked on key approval itself. Today's smoke test can't cover protected reads yet.
lines.zh: 仍受密钥审批本身阻塞。今天关键功能测试暂不能覆盖受保护读取。

lines.en: Just to confirm, masked data in testing, right? No customer export into an open bucket.
lines.zh: 确认一下，测试使用脱敏数据，对吧？不能把客户导出放到公开桶。

lines.en: Yes, access is restricted and data masked. The permission test uses approved synthetic credentials.
lines.zh: 对，访问受限且数据脱敏。权限测试使用批准的合成凭据。

lines.en: Maybe the lower quota changes load results. I'll label functional and capacity checks separately.
lines.zh: 较低配额可能改变带载结果。我分别标注功能和容量检查。

lines.en: A larger test account? Let's park that. First confirm what evidence the existing environment supplies.
lines.zh: 扩大测试账户？先放一边。先确认现有环境能提供什么证据。

lines.en: I'll document the representative datasets this morning. Reviewers need to know which edge cases remain.
lines.zh: 上午我记录代表性数据集。评审者要知道剩余哪些边界情况。

lines.en: Okay, keep those gaps on the board. Provisioned doesn't mean ready for every test.
lines.zh: 好，把缺口保留在看板。资源已建不等于所有测试已就绪。

dialogues.title: 演练不能授权生产切换
dialogues.premise: 测试环境边界明确，站会列出未来切换评审所需材料。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住生产切换的前置条件及写入回退复杂性。

lines.en: First, every cutover dependency needs an owner. Data validation, capacity, and write control come first.
lines.zh: 先明确，每项切换依赖都需负责人。先准备数据验证、容量和写入控制。

lines.en: Right, the replication checkpoint supports data acceptance. We'll need a controlled write pause at cutover.
lines.zh: 对，复制检查点支持数据验收。切换时需要受控暂停写入。

lines.en: Routing changes need their own reviewed sequence. Maybe DNS caching extends the transition window.
lines.zh: 路由变更需要独立评审顺序。DNS缓存可能延长过渡窗口。

lines.en: Well, environment parity won't prove data-safe rollback. New target writes require a data-safe return strategy.
lines.zh: 嗯，环境一致不能证明数据安全回退。目标新增写入需要数据安全的返回策略。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Friday isn't go/no-go, right? That decision waits for a separate change review.
lines.zh: 确认一下，周五不做生产继续或停止决定，对吧？等独立变更评审。

lines.en: Correct, reverting DNS alone isn't enough itself. We must account for writes already accepted there.
lines.zh: 对，单独改回DNS本身不够。必须处理目标已接收的写入。

lines.en: Define the rollback trigger and safe boundary. Before target writes, fallback differs from after writes.
lines.zh: 明确回退触发条件和安全边界。目标写入前后回退不同。

lines.en: I'll bring the routing draft by Thursday. Today I'm validating paths, not scheduling production changes.
lines.zh: 周四前带路由草案。今天验证路径，不安排生产变更。

lines.en: I own the identity validation evidence package. It includes failed access tests as well.
lines.zh: 我负责身份验证证据包，也包含拒绝访问测试。

lines.en: Okay, put those owners beside each dependency. No implied approval from a green progress board.
lines.zh: 好，每项依赖旁写负责人。进度看板变绿不隐含批准。

dialogues.title: 风险标黄，不隐瞒不确定性
dialogues.premise: 权限与数据检查仍待完成，重新评估周五测试里程碑。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出延期风险与已延期之间的区别。

lines.en: So, is Friday's milestone at risk now? We've got two dependencies without completed acceptance checks.
lines.zh: 所以，周五里程碑现在有风险吗？两项依赖尚未完成验收。

lines.en: Maybe, if copy throughput falls overnight again. Our working hypothesis assumes today's rate continues.
lines.zh: 可能，如果夜间复制吞吐再次下降。当前假设是今天速率持续。

lines.en: Well, don't call everything on track unqualified. Mark confidence separately from the scheduled date.
lines.zh: 嗯，别无条件说全部按计划。置信程度和排定日期分别标注。

lines.en: The network work is on track itself. Whole-project confidence depends on permissions and data checks.
lines.zh: 网络工作本身按计划。整个项目置信程度取决于权限和数据检查。

lines.en: Right, we're blocked on review, not implementation. My policy request is ready for security.
lines.zh: 对，受阻于评审，不是实现。策略申请已准备给安全团队。

lines.en: What's the ETA for a decision update? Give me the next checkpoint, not a guarantee.
lines.zh: 决策更新预计何时？给下一检查点，不作保证。

lines.en: This afternoon's review should clarify the risk. If it slips, shorten scope before extending hours.
lines.zh: 下午评审应能明确风险。若延期，先缩范围再考虑延长工时。

lines.en: We could rehearse networking without final data. But label it as a partial rehearsal.
lines.zh: 可以未有最终数据先演练网络。但要标为部分演练。

lines.en: Agreed, but that won't satisfy data acceptance. Keep the missing evidence visible afterward too.
lines.zh: 同意，但那不能满足数据验收。之后也保留缺失证据标记。

lines.en: Just to recap, Friday has conditional confidence. We'll update the date if gates stay incomplete.
lines.zh: 小结一下，周五只有条件置信。门槛仍不完整就更新日期。

dialogues.title: 具体请求，比泛泛求助更有效
dialogues.premise: 里程碑标注条件风险，团队安排评审与测试支援。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出谁需要什么帮助以及原责任是否改变。

lines.en: So, could Lukas pair on this test? I need a reviewer for return-path coverage.
lines.zh: 那Lukas能结对做这个测试吗？需要评审回程路径覆盖。

lines.en: Yes, I've got bandwidth after eleven today. You keep ownership; I'll challenge the test cases.
lines.zh: 可以，今天十一点后有空。你保留责任，我检查测试用例。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for checksum review? My data specialist is out of station.
lines.zh: 校验和评审谁接？我的数据专家不在本地。

lines.en: Well, I can review the comparison method. A domain owner still signs data acceptance.
lines.zh: 嗯，我能评审比较方法。数据验收仍由领域负责人签。

lines.en: Okay, support doesn't transfer the decision itself. Anika stays accountable for the data gate.
lines.zh: 好，支援不转移决策本身。Anika仍对数据门槛负责。

lines.en: Right, what's the ETA for that slot? Maybe an hour covers the route matrix.
lines.zh: 好，那个时段预计何时？路由矩阵可能一小时。

lines.en: Eleven to noon works on my calendar. Send the topology and expected paths beforehand.
lines.zh: 我日程十一点到十二点可行。提前发拓扑和预期路径。

lines.en: We're blocked on one specialist's sign-off too. I'll ask her backup to review remotely.
lines.zh: 还受一个专家签字阻塞。我请她的替补远程评审。

lines.en: Anyway, let's take it offline for details. They don't need everyone's standup time today.
lines.zh: 总之，细节会后单聊。不需要占大家今天站会时间。

lines.en: I'll note these slots on the board. Raise conflicts early rather than assuming overtime.
lines.zh: 我把时段记到看板。冲突提前说，不默认加班。

dialogues.title: 承诺可控交付，不承诺外部审批
dialogues.premise: 支援时段确定，站会收敛本周各自可控的成果。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分承诺、目标与条件依赖。

lines.en: Okay, let's define ready for testing precisely. Friday needs approved identity, validated data, and paths.
lines.zh: 好，精确定义测试就绪。周五需批准身份、验证数据和路径。

lines.en: And documented gaps in production capacity evidence. Testing readiness isn't a production release commitment.
lines.zh: 还要记录生产容量证据缺口。测试就绪不是生产发布承诺。

lines.en: My action item is both-zone path evidence. I'll close the loop by Thursday noon.
lines.zh: 我的待办是两区路径证据。周四中午前闭环。

lines.en: I'll publish validation results and lag trends. Maybe Friday readiness holds if throughput stays steady.
lines.zh: 我发布验证结果和延迟趋势。吞吐稳定则周五可能就绪。

lines.en: Well, I commit to the policy request. I can't guarantee an external approval date.
lines.zh: 嗯，我承诺完成策略申请。不能保证外部批准日期。

lines.en: Just to confirm, a milestone at risk, right? Not a failed project or an incident.
lines.zh: 确认一下，是里程碑有风险，对吧？不是项目失败或故障。

lines.en: Correct, adjust expectations without hiding incomplete checks. We'll reschedule testing if acceptance gates don't pass.
lines.zh: 对，调整预期但不隐瞒未完整检查。验收门槛不通过就重排测试。

lines.en: So, network delivery stays on track this week. The whole test date remains conditional on others.
lines.zh: 所以，网络交付本周按计划。整体测试日期仍受其他条件约束。

lines.en: I'll post the approval outcome after review. Denials need reasons and a revised request.
lines.zh: 评审后发布审批结果。拒绝需要原因和修订申请。

lines.en: Okay, I'll keep estimates visibly separate too. Nobody should read a target as a promise.
lines.zh: 好，我也明确区分估算。别让大家把目标读成承诺。

dialogues.title: 下午更新依赖，明早不重复读看板
dialogues.premise: 周内承诺已记录，收尾确定异步更新与升级安排。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住更新时间、负责人和里程碑调整规则。

lines.en: Okay, post a dependency update at four. Use owners, next steps, and changed estimates.
lines.zh: 好，四点发布依赖更新。写负责人、下一步和变化估时。

lines.en: I'll include the permission review outcome today. The escalation path stays with the security reviewer.
lines.zh: 今天包含权限评审结果。升级路径仍是安全评审者。

lines.en: Maybe we can circle back tomorrow morning. Only discuss changes that affect the shared plan.
lines.zh: 明早可以再跟进。只讨论影响共同计划的变化。

lines.en: Well, keep debugging in the working sessions. Standup should expose dependencies, not reproduce every test.
lines.zh: 嗯，调试留到工作会。站会暴露依赖，不重放每个测试。

lines.en: Right, ready for testing needs evidence first. The data gate needs acceptance itself.
lines.zh: 对，测试就绪先要证据。数据门槛本身需要验收。

lines.en: Just to recap, no production cutover this week. A milestone at risk gets an explicit update.
lines.zh: 小结一下，本周不生产切换。风险里程碑要明确更新。

lines.en: Link evidence rather than copying sensitive details. Reviewers can use the restricted test record.
lines.zh: 链接证据，不复制敏感细节。评审者使用受限测试记录。

lines.en: I'll update the route matrix after pairing. Any new gap gets an owner before tomorrow.
lines.zh: 结对后更新路由矩阵。明天前给每个新缺口指定负责人。

lines.en: So, revise Friday if Thursday's gates remain open. Don't compress review just to preserve the date.
lines.zh: 所以，周四门槛仍未完成，就调整周五安排。别为保日期压缩评审。

lines.en: Okay, I'll send the shared summary now. My next step is the checksum comparison.
lines.zh: 好，现在发送共同摘要。我的下一步是校验和比较。
